column3: The oath repeats if and explicitly mentions the tent of my house and the couch of my beds.
The repeated if continues the oath formula.
Behold introduces the verse; it says we heard of her rather than explicitly stating that the ark was there.
Dwelling places is plural; the footstool is explicitly that of His feet.
The request literally concerns not turning away the face of the anointed.
The oath is characterized as truth. A descendant is expressed as one from the fruit of your belly.
The final object is it, referring back to Zion, without repeating home.
Blessing is emphatically repeated rather than abundance modifying the provisions.
The joyful shout is emphatically repeated.
